About parking signs

Parking signs keep car parks organised and make it clear who can park where. Whether you're reserving bays for staff and visitors, marking disabled spaces or setting out rules for a private car park, clear signs prevent arguments and keep traffic moving safely.

Our car park signs cover visitor, staff, customer, permit, residents and disabled parking, as well as speed limits, reverse parking, directional arrows and private road and property notices. Most are available in several sizes, in portrait or landscape, and many come with arrow options.

Signs are made from weatherproof materials for outdoor use and can be fixed to walls, fences or posts. If you need different wording, your logo, or a whole set of matching signs for a site, we can make custom parking signs to order.

Looking for signs to stop people parking? See no parking signs. For more safety signage, browse our safety and warning signs.

Parking Signs FAQs

Can't see your question? Call 01603 407786 or send an enquiry.

Are private parking signs enforceable?

Signs show your rules, but enforcing parking charges on private land must follow the relevant parking code of practice, with signs that meet its requirements. If you plan to enforce, speak to an approved parking operator first.

Can you add our logo or custom wording?

Yes. We can make any parking sign with your own wording, colours and logo.

Which material lasts best outdoors?

Aluminium composite is the most durable choice for permanent outdoor parking signs.

Can parking signs go on posts?

Yes. They can be fixed to posts, walls, fences and railings. See our post mounted signs.
